usageNotes: Use this to enable or disable an existing APT repository entry on a specific node — it cannot add or remove repository lines, only toggle them. The `path` and `index` together uniquely identify the repository entry within its source file (indexes are 0-based as returned by GET /nodes/{node}/apt/repositories). Pass the `digest` from the GET response to guard against concurrent modifications; the call will fail if the file has changed since you last read it.

examples.summary: Disable the Proxmox enterprise repository on node pve1

tips: Fetch the current repository list with GET /nodes/{node}/apt/repositories first — that response gives you the correct path, index, and digest values required here.
The digest is optional but strongly recommended in automated workflows; omitting it risks silently overwriting a concurrent change.
This endpoint returns null on success; an HTTP 4xx/5xx response indicates failure (e.g., stale digest, wrong path, or insufficient privilege).
Changes take effect immediately for subsequent apt commands — no node restart required.
